‘No:ELI/Gross WagesinECR/2025/E-1132964 ~ Date:22.07.2025
CIRCULAR
Subject: Furnishing accurate Gross wages in monthly ECR for the of availing benefit

under Employment Linked Incentive Scheme — regarding

The Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) Scheme envisages incentives to employer and
employees, wherein the eligibility for the incentive is available only in such cases, where the gross
wage does not exceed Rs. One Lakh for any employee.

Hence, it has become imperative that all employers to submit information relating to gross
wages of employees in the respective field of ECR correctly.

In view of the above, it is hereby reiterated that all employers must ensure correct entry
relating to gross wages in the ECR to be filed from wage month August 2025 onwards.

All Zones/ Regional offices / District offices are requested to give wide publicity of the above
noted requirement of furnishing correct gross wages in the ECR by establishments under their
respective jurisdiction.

(This issues with the approval of the Central Provident Fund Commissioner)
